instruction: Use the original California DMV REAL ID decision infographic PDF on the Desktop. Create a Sticky Note recording the travel/federal-facility question, what the chart says when a traveler already has a valid passport, military ID, or other federally approved document, what it says when the traveler does not have one, and the in-person action shown for getting a REAL ID.
gt_steps: Open Sticky Notes and create a new note.

Enter the following text:
`Question: Do you travel by airplane or visit federal facilities?
Federally approved document: YES - You DO NOT need a REAL ID
Federally approved document: NO - You WILL NEED a REAL ID
Action: Visit a DMV office with the required documents`
